agent_explanations_oldest_first.text:
The ablation works in the predicted direction, but only partly. P("However") at the doubt decisions fell from 0.79 to 0.54. Control decisions are unaffected (+0.004 nats), and answer-token log-probabilities barely move (−0.003 on cut texts, −0.001 on controls), so the edit is selective and causes no general damage.

"However" is still the top token in 46 of 74 cases. The 28 replacements are ordinary continuations ("The", "We", "Since", "Let"). So these eight neurons carry part of the doubt signal, and attention or other units carry the rest.

To test the dose-response, I'll go one step stronger on the same eight neurons: reverse their down_proj columns (×−1) instead of zeroing them. If P("However") falls further, toward about 0.3, with controls still unaffected, the lever has slope. A doubt-free version may then be strong enough to test in generation. If it plateaus near 0.54, the remaining signal is elsewhere, and I'll look at layer 17's attention.

E3 is saved: the same eight doubt-neuron columns, reversed (×−1) from the original weights. I'm running the same teacher-forced readout. A further drop in P("However") below 0.54 with controls intact shows the lever has slope; a plateau sends me to layer 17's attention.

Reversing the columns gives a clear dose-response. P("However") at the doubt decisions falls from 0.79 (original) to 0.54 (zeroed) to 0.24 (reversed). It is now top-1 in only 20 of 74 cases, replaced by ordinary continuations ("The", "Since", "We").

The cost is small. The true token at control decisions loses 0.003 nats, and mean answer-token log-probability falls by 0.011 on cut texts and 0.003 on controls. So the eight neurons do drive the doubt-and-restart token, and reversing them mostly removes the reflex.

Now the real test is accuracy, in generation. I'll run a paired "both" pass with E3 alone, without n3729, so the doubt mechanism is measured on its own. To avoid testing on the problems whose answers selected the neurons, the set is DEV[1024:1200] (176 untouched problems), plus 80 DEV problems that were in none of the pass-10 texts.

How to read the result:
- **Confirmed:** fewer cuts and a positive paired accuracy difference of about +2 points or more.
- **Refuted:** fewer cuts but flat accuracy. That would mean the doubt was a symptom of being stuck, not a cause of failure.
